translationRepairs: On renchen Zhang Kai, Duke of Shangdang, and Princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were recalled and made marshals.
On renchen Zhang Kai, Duke of Shangdang, and Princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were raised and made marshals.
In Jin annalistic style 起X為Y means raise/appoint X as Y; the original 'recalled' invents a return from elsewhere absent from the Chinese.
On renchen Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai and the princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were recalled and made marshals.
On renchen Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai and the princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were raised and made marshals.
Literal likewise mistranslates 起…為 as 'recalled'; the Chinese only records raising them to marshal.
On wei a placard called the people to sell grain and pay next year's military-supply levy; wealthy households' land rent was levied the same way.
On yiwei a placard called the people to sell grain and pay next year's military-supply levy; wealthy households' land rent was levied the same way.
乙未 is the sexagenary day yiwei; reading only 'wei' drops the stem 乙.
On wei an edict by placard called the people to sell and remit next year's military-supply tax; wealthy households' land rent likewise.
On yiwei an edict by placard called the people to sell and remit next year's military-supply tax; wealthy households' land rent likewise.
Literal also truncates 乙未 to 'wei'; the full day name is yiwei.
Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial troops; eastern marshal Gao Xian and fruit-steadfast commandant Niange Yaozhu took ten thousand as vanguard to Pucheng.
Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial troops; eastern marshal Gao Xian and Guoyi commandant Niange Yaozhu took ten thousand as vanguard to Pucheng.
果毅都尉 is the office title Guoyi commandant; 'fruit-steadfast' is a false calque of the title characters.
Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial Army men; Eastern Marshal Gao Xian and Fruit-Steadfast Commandant Niange Yaozhu led ten thousand as vanguard, reaching Pucheng.
Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial Army men; Eastern Marshal Gao Xian and Guoyi Commandant Niange Yaozhu led ten thousand as vanguard, reaching Pucheng.
Literal likewise must render 果毅 as the title Guoyi, not 'Fruit-Steadfast'.

His brother Yi became participation councillor; Kan became palace front commandant; Bolüluoge, his partisan, censor-in-chief; Han Duo vice marshal and Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda marshals; Shi Su a department director; Jia Liang military affairs director and right department chief; Wendihan Ershi minister of works and Liu Zhongzhou vice minister of personnel participation councillors; Aotun Shunqing left vice minister; Zhang Zhenglun right vice minister; Zhang Jie department director; Yuan Haowen, a ministry clerk, deputy director; Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang department chiefs.

His brother Yi became equal-rank minister; Kan became palace front commandant; Bolüluoge, his partisan, vice censor-in-chief; Han Duo vice marshal and Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda marshals; Shi Su a department director; Jia Liang military affairs director and right department chief; Wendihan Ershi minister of works and Liu Zhongzhou vice minister of personnel participation councillors; Aotun Shunqing left vice minister; Zhang Zhenglun right vice minister; Zhang Jie department director; Yuan Haowen, a ministry clerk, deputy director; Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang department chiefs.
弟倚平章政事 is equal-rank minister, distinct from later 參知政事; 御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief, not 御史大夫.

His younger brother Yi was Participation Councillor; Kan was Palace Front Commandant; his clique member Bolüluoge was Censor-in-Chief; Han Duo was Vice Marshal and concurrent Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda were all marshals; Shi Su was a Left and Right Department director; Jia Liang was Bureau of Military Affairs director and concurrent Right Department chief; he also appointed Minister of Works Wendihan Ershi and Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Zhongzhou as participation councillors; Palace Intendant Aotun Shunqing as Left Vice Minister, Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Zhenglun as Right Vice Minister; Department chief Zhang Jie as director; archival clerk Yuan Haowen as deputy director; and transport officials Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang as department chiefs.

His younger brother Yi was Equal-Rank Minister; Kan was Palace Front Commandant; his clique member Bolüluoge was Vice Censor-in-Chief; Han Duo was Vice Marshal and concurrent Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda were all marshals; Shi Su was a Left and Right Department director; Jia Liang was Bureau of Military Affairs director and concurrent Right Department chief; he also appointed Minister of Works Wendihan Ershi and Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Zhongzhou as participation councillors; Palace Intendant Aotun Shunqing as Left Vice Minister, Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Zhenglun as Right Vice Minister; Department chief Zhang Jie as director; archival clerk Yuan Haowen as deputy director; and transport officials Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang as department chiefs.
Literal conflates 平章政事 with Participation Councillor and 御史中丞 with Censor-in-Chief; both ranks are distinct in the Chinese.
Revenue clerk Zheng Zhao refused summons.
Revenue clerk Zheng Zhu refused summons.
鄭著 is Zheng Zhu; Zhao would require the surname 趙, which is not in the text.

That day Right Deputy Commandant Wendun Ali, Left and Right Palace Gentlemen Attendant Yuanlang Nie Tianji, Censor-in-Chief Peiman Ahudai, Remonstrance Official and Department Director Wugulun Nushen, Left Deputy Commandant Wanyan Asan, Palace Attendant Mangge, and Lecturer Pucha Qi were all killed.

That day Right Deputy Commandant Wendun Ali, Left and Right Palace Gentlemen Attendant Nie Tianji, Censor-in-Chief Peiman Ahudai, Remonstrance Official and Department Director Wugulun Nushen, Left Deputy Commandant Wanyan Asan, Palace Attendant Mangge, and Lecturer Pucha Qi were all killed.
The Chinese names only 聶天驥 after the office 左右懷員外郎; 'Yuanlang' is an invented personal name.
On wuchen Guan Nu mutinied with the Loyal-Benevolence Army, killed Ma Yong, then slew Li Xi, Shi Zannü Luhuan, Tushan Changle, and over three hundred courtiers through the right vice director.
On wuchen Guan Nu mutinied with the Loyal-and-Filial Army, killed Ma Yong, then slew Li Xi, Shi Zannü Luhuan, Tushan Changle, and over three hundred courtiers through the right vice director.
忠孝軍 is Loyal-and-Filial Army; 'Loyal-Benevolence' misreads 孝 and breaks identity with the same force named earlier.

On wuchen Guan Nu raised the Loyal-Benevolence Army in revolt, attacked and killed Ma Yong, then killed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Li Xi, Participation Councillor Shi Zannü Luhuan, Inspector Tushan Changle, and more than three hundred attendants from the right vice director down.

On wuchen Guan Nu raised the Loyal-and-Filial Army in revolt, attacked and killed Ma Yong, then killed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Li Xi, Participation Councillor Shi Zannü Luhuan, Inspector Tushan Changle, and more than three hundred attendants from the right vice director down.
Literal repeats the same mistranslation of 忠孝軍 as Loyal-Benevolence.
Guan Nu lodged above the emperor in the Zhaobi Hall, and no inner-court minister dared address him.
Guan Nu made the emperor reside in the Zhaobi Hall, and no inner-court minister dared address him.
以上居照碧堂 means Guan Nu had His Majesty dwell in Zhaobi Hall; 'lodged above the emperor' reverses 以+上居.
Guan Nu lived above the emperor in the Zhaobi Hall; none of the inner-court ministers dared present memorials or audience.
Guan Nu made the emperor live in the Zhaobi Hall; none of the inner-court ministers dared present memorials or audience.
Literal likewise reverses the causative 以上居; the emperor was housed in the hall, as the following imprisonment speech confirms.
In the fourth summer month, on renwu, Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu seized Wang Dequan and his son and executed them with partisans Wang Lin, Yang Jin, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
In the fourth summer month, on renwu, Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu seized Wang Dequan and his son and executed them with partisans Wang Lin, Yang Gui, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
楊璝 is Yang Gui; Jin invents a wrong given name for 璝.
Summer, fourth month, renwu: Xuzhou Traveling Secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu arrested Wang Dequan and his son and executed them, together with their partisans Wang Lin, Yang Jin, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
Summer, fourth month, renwu: Xuzhou Traveling Secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu arrested Wang Dequan and his son and executed them, together with their partisans Wang Lin, Yang Gui, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
Literal has the same wrong given name for 楊璝; Gui is required.
The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-Benevolence Army, and calmed the unrest.
The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-and-Filial Army, and calmed the unrest.
赦忠孝軍 again requires Loyal-and-Filial Army, matching the earlier correct force name.
The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-Benevolence Army, and settled the shaken.
The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-and-Filial Army, and settled the shaken.
Literal repeats Loyal-Benevolence for 忠孝軍; Loyal-and-Filial is required.

On bingchen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang made Fuge military commissioner on his own authority, stopped the armor-and-grain levy, and the prefecture settled.

On bingshen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang made Fuge military commissioner on his own authority, stopped the armor-and-grain levy, and the prefecture settled.
丙申 is bingshen; bingchen would be 丙辰, a different day.

On bingchen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang by expedient authority made Fuge military commissioner, halted the iron-armor and grain transport, and the prefecture was calmed.

On bingshen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang by expedient authority made Fuge military commissioner, halted the iron-armor and grain transport, and the prefecture was calmed.
Literal likewise misreads 丙申 as bingchen instead of bingshen.
On yimao Wei Jun was dispatched to rally Wu Xian’s army.
On yimao Wei Fan was dispatched to rally Wu Xian’s army.
魏璠 is Wei Fan; Jun invents a wrong reading of 璠.
On yimao Wei Jun was sent to summon Wu Xian’s troops.
On yimao Wei Fan was sent to summon Wu Xian’s troops.
Literal likewise misrenders 魏璠 as Wei Jun; Fan is required.
Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jue plotted to flee to Caizhou; Wu Xian chased Zhi in vain and killed Jue.
Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jie plotted to flee to Caizhou; Wu Xian chased Zhi in vain and killed Jie.
石玠 is Shi Jie; Jue invents a wrong reading of 玠.
Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jue plotted to return to Caizhou; Wu Xian pursued Zhi without catching him and killed Jue.
Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jie plotted to return to Caizhou; Wu Xian pursued Zhi without catching him and killed Jie.
Literal likewise misreads 石玠 as Shi Jue; Jie is required.

On yisi Urgun Hao was made censor-in-chief with his supreme command unchanged; Zhang Tiangang was censor-in-chief and still acting participation councillor; Wanyan Yaoshi was Pacify-South Army military commissioner and also Caizhou circuit observer.

On yisi Urgun Hao was made censor-in-chief with his supreme command unchanged; Zhang Tiangang was chief censor and still acting participation councillor; Wanyan Yaoshi was Pacify-South Army military commissioner and also Caizhou circuit observer.
烏古論鎬 gets 御史大夫 while 張天綱 is 御史中丞; literal wrongly gives both censor-in-chief.
On bingxu an edict sent acting Participation Councillor Monian Udian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to head the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.
On bingxu an edict sent acting Participation Councillor Monian Wudian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to head the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.
抹撚兀典 is Monian Wudian; Udian is a wrong romanization of 兀典 already rendered Wudian elsewhere.
On bingxu an edict ordered acting Participation Councillor Monian Udian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to run the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.
On bingxu an edict ordered acting Participation Councillor Monian Wudian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to run the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.
Literal inconsistently romanizes 兀典 as Udian; Wudian matches the Chinese and earlier usage.
On renchen Monian Udian at the Xi traveling secretariat raided Song at Zhongdu Ford with heavy kills and captures.
On renchen Monian Wudian at the Xi traveling secretariat raided Song at Zhongdu Ford with heavy kills and captures.
Same person 抹撚兀典 must remain Monian Wudian; Udian is an erroneous spelling.
On renchen Xi traveling secretariat Monian Udian with troops raided Song at Zhongdu Ford and took many heads and captives.
On renchen Xi traveling secretariat Monian Wudian with troops raided Song at Zhongdu Ford and took many heads and captives.
Literal again misspells 兀典 as Udian; Wudian is required.
On guimao Xuzhou defender Guo En killed and drove out officials in revolt; traveling secretariat chief Saib executed him.
On guiwei Xuzhou defender Guo En killed and drove out officials in revolt; traveling secretariat chief Saib executed him.
癸未 is guiwei; guimao would be 癸卯, a different day.
On guimao Xuzhou defender Guo En killed and expelled officials in rebellion; the traveling secretariat Saib put him to death.
On guiwei Xuzhou defender Guo En killed and expelled officials in rebellion; the traveling secretariat Saib put him to death.
Literal likewise misreads 癸未 as guimao instead of guiwei.

On bingshen Left Deputy Chief Inspector Wendun Changsun was killed in battle.
